epics.title: Customer Onboarding
epics.description: Enable a new retail banking customer to open a current account entirely digitally: capture personal and identity details, upload KYC verification documents, route the application to a compliance officer for review, and keep the customer informed of status at every stage. Must support both individual and joint applicants.
epics.capability: Digital account opening with KYC verification
acceptance_criteria: Customer can submit identity details online, including for a joint applicant
Customer can upload supporting documents (ID, proof of address)
Compliance officer can review, approve, or reject submissions with a reason code
Customer receives status notifications by email at each stage transition
Rejected applications can be resubmitted once with corrected information
nfr_mapping: Data privacy (PII encryption at rest and in transit)
Audit trail for all compliance decisions

epics.title: Account Funding
epics.description: Once an account is approved, allow the customer to fund it via bank transfer or debit card, and view their starting balance.
acceptance_criteria: Customer can initiate a funding transfer from an external bank account
Customer can fund via debit card with real-time confirmation
Customer can view current balance after funding completes
